SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_quarter,
  CASE 
    WHEN fsl.channel_code = 'WB' THEN 'Web shop'
    ELSE s.region 
  END as region,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount - COALESCE(frl.refund_net, 0)) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON fsl.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
  AND fsl.channel_code IN ('ST', 'WB')
  AND (fsl.channel_code = 'WB' OR s.store_id < 900)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, CASE WHEN fsl.channel_code = 'WB' THEN 'Web shop' ELSE s.region END
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, region;

WITH store_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.region,
    SUM(rds.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rds
  LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON rds.business_date = d.calendar_date
  LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON rds.store_id = s.store_id AND d.calendar_date >= s.valid_from AND d.calendar_date <= s.valid_to
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    AND rds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.region
),
web_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    'Web shop' as region,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount - COALESCE(frl.refund_net, 0)) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    AND fsl.channel_code = 'WB'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
),
combined_sales AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, region, net_sales FROM store_sales
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fiscal_year, region, net_sales FROM web_sales
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) as last_year_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) as prior_year_sales
  FROM combined_sales
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  last_year_sales,
  prior_year_sales,
  CASE 
    WHEN prior_year_sales != 0 THEN ROUND((last_year_sales - prior_year_sales) / prior_year_sales * 100, 2)
    ELSE NULL
  END as growth_percentage
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY region;
